status: frozen before executing the new study; exploratory reused archives, not a fresh holdout
scope: offline research only; no production scorer, decision, default, history, official row or cost changes
day_policy: all rows of one normalized date use the same strictly earlier forecast and pool; counts and evidence update only after that complete day
weighted_draw_model: P(D|past)=product(w[n] for n in D)/e_draw_n(w[1..universe]); unordered distinct-number draws

predictors.evidence: prequential exact likelihood from the first complete archive day, with forecasts frozen within days; log-space expert likelihood ratios against uniform
predictors.mixture: posterior model probabilities proportional to initial priors times the prequential expert likelihoods
predictors.ranking: posterior mixture of weights normalized to mean1; subtract the uniform constant and divide by nonuniform posterior mass for numerical stability, an equivalent ranking
predictors.objective_comparison: conditional nonuniform posterior mixture of exact official-scheme P5+/P6; the uniform component is pool-invariant so cancels exactly

baseline: registered frequency scorer through call_method and canonical select_pool_from_scores; no replacement or hidden fallback
model_topk: canonical selection of mixture scores, fixed pool_n and max_consecutive_run2

lr_tail.proposal_rule: at each pass replace each of six weakest current members with each of four highest ranked outsiders; keep distinct valid pools satisfying maxrun2; ranking frozen for the day
lr_tail.terminal_mapping: official positional rows applied to ascending numeric pool; never remap positions
lr_tail.acceptance: neither exact model endpoint decreases beyond relative tolerance1e-12 and at least one increases beyond tolerance; P6 applies only to six-number rows
lr_tail.choice: among acceptable proposals choose maximum P5+, then P6, then lexicographically largest ascending pool; stop when no acceptable proposal

gated_lr_tail.gate: equal-weight mixture of the two nonuniform experts' prequential likelihood ratios versus uniform, based only on completed prior days
gated_lr_tail.interpretation: under conditional independent uniform draws this nonnegative e-process gives anytime false opening <=1/60 per game, <=5% union bound across3 games; opening supports nonuniform predictive-distribution evidence, not proof of5+/6+ lift

primary_window: last30% of eligible distinct draw dates, split at floor(0.70*eligible_days); every row of a date stays together
diagnostic_window: all rows with strictly earlier training cutoff>=250; counts only, no extra significance tests
endpoints: pool5+ for all games; pool6 for6/49 and5/40; official best-ticket5+ for all games; official best-ticket6 only6/49. Joker refers to urn1, no Joker-ball/category inference.5/40 uses all6 extracted numbers, no first5/category inference.

comparisons.primary: each of model_topk, lr_tail and gated_lr_tail versus frequency using one-sided exact paired discordant-event binomial test; versus exact uniform pool/scheme odds using one-sided binomial test
comparisons.multiplicity: one Holm family containing every primary candidate/game/endpoint/comparator test (54 expected); marginal95% Clopper-Pearson intervals are not selection-adjusted
comparisons.tail_vs_topk: descriptive paired wins/losses only, no additional p-value or selection
comparisons.selection: report all fixed candidates; no posthoc winner, model, parameter or cost selection

integrity: SHA256 fingerprints of frozen protocol, input CSV bytes, actual official rows and runner/objective/scorer/core code; write isolated NPZ and JSON artifacts; SHA256 is integrity fingerprinting, not a digital signature
failure_policy: invalid input, scheme, scores, geometry, nonfinite probabilities or violated constraints fail the study; no silent omission or alternate scorer
promotion: none; reused historical outcomes are exploratory, any claimed advantage requires prospective or independent external confirmation
